The Poisonburst Arrow Acolyte of Chayula build obliterates monsters by causing an absolute ruckus of poison, bleed, and chaos explosions. Once the Acolyte of Chayula "awakens" from his dream, the build ramps further by becoming the
, which is a buff that summons Chaos Tornadoes, and these create even more havoc.

. Defensively the build goes for Evasion, Energy Shield, and Deflection. Chaos resistance is easy thanks to
Offensively the build has great scaling,
literally triples the DPS of the build! And if that wasn't enough
has amazing synergy with the Chaos Tornadoes from
, causing them to explode almost immediately.
The Poisonburst Arrow Acolyte of Chayula character has extremely satisfying map clear explosions that spread with Poison and Bleed.
all work together to make everything inevitably blow up.
has respectable clear on it's own, and further increases the offscreen potential of the build.

is an amazing addition, both for clear, and single target. The Chaos Tornadoes it summons adds nice visuals to the build while also being mechanically very strong, causing everything to be fully withered, increasing the damage of the build greatly. If that wasn't enough, it has perfect synergy with the main single target ability of this build
, exploding the pustules as they spawn.
and it's Purple Flames, ramp the builds damage up to absurd levels, making it the perfect choice for a poison build!
